confirm.description: Home Assistant will connect once to check the model.

data.label: Label (default: last 4 digits of the serial)

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Move closer or try again.

abort.already_configured: This monitor is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup of this monitor is already in progress.
abort.no_devices_found: No RadonEye monitors heard by Home Assistant's Bluetooth.
abort.unsupported_model: Not supported: only RadonEye RD200 v2/v3 (RD200 v1 uses a different protocol).

data.label: Label
data.parallel_with_rd200_ble: Parallel run: read rd200_ble in its own slot

remove_yaml.title: Remove reliable_radoneye from YAML
remove_yaml.description: The RadonEye monitors were imported from YAML. Check they appear under Settings → Devices & services → Reliable RadonEye, then delete the `reliable_radoneye:` block from configuration (for example packages/reliable_radoneye.yaml).

window_not_recognised.title: Radon {label}: counting window not recognised
window_not_recognised.description: This monitor's particle counts don't follow the 10-minute window seen on RD200V3 firmware V3.0.1, so counts-based radon is off. The device's own values are still read every 5 minutes.

pull.name: Pull RadonEye logs
pull.description: Queue each monitor's stored hourly log for the next read slot (or now).

immediate.name: Now
immediate.description: Run now instead of in the next slot (may collide with a second poller).
